summary: Viridon Path 15 LLC files tariff revisions under section 205 on November 16, 2026, in ER27-523-000, answering the CAISO show cause order. It owns only a transmission service rights interest in the Path 15 Upgrade, so interconnection requests route to WAPA, PG&E or CAISO. It files no cost recovery mechanism and no pro forma interconnection agreement.
ask: Accept the revisions without hearing or suspension, effective February 16, 2027.

points.point: Viridon owns only a service rights interest in Path 15. WAPA owns the physical facilities.
points.quote: The Western Area Power Administration (“WAPA”) owns the physical transmission infrastructure constituting the Path 15 Upgrade

points.point: It says it could not fully align with the other owners in the time available.
points.quote: given the short timeframe, the complexity of issues involved, and the large number of PTOs, it was not possible to coordinate in perfect lockstep with all other PTOs

points.point: It requires applicants to disclose other requests for the same large load or its affiliates.
points.quote: disclosure of any other interconnection requests to the ISO Controlled Grid the applicant has filed on behalf of the same Large Load or any of its affiliate(s)

points.point: It proposes a coordination process between owners and argues a process favoring load-serving owners' facilities would not be just and reasonable.
points.quote: A large load interconnection process that favored connecting to load serving entity PTO facilities would not be just and reasonable

points.point: It files no cost recovery mechanism of its own.
points.quote: the TO Tariff Revisions do not include a separate pro forma Large Load Interconnection Agreement or cost recovery mechanisms

points.point: Co-located loads would be studied net of the co-located generation's output.
points.quote: facilities will be studied based on their expected load on the transmission system, net of the co- located generation’s output that offsets the large load’s energy usage

points.point: It says curtailment duties for the interim service must be enforceable.
points.quote: for the FILLI offering to function as intended, curtailment obligations must be enforceable and the chain of authority must be clear

points.point: It proposes no tariff changes on electrically proximate generation, following CAISO.
points.quote: Viridon Path 15 does not propose making any changes to its Path 15 Tariff on this issue

throughLine.text: Filed under section 205 to answer the E-10 show cause order. It aligns with CAISO's draft tariff language on definition, study and interim service, and defers cost recovery and the interconnection agreement to the other owners' work.
